title: AI Citation Revenue Leak Map
oneLiner: A publisher survival console that shows which pages are being cited by AI search while losing clicks, sponsors, and affiliate revenue.
targetUser: Independent publishers, niche review sites, affiliate operators, SEO consultants, creator newsletters, and local media teams facing AI-search traffic erosion.
keyUx: Import search-console rows, top content URLs, AI citation sightings, sponsor/affiliate value, and update cadence; the app maps click leakage by page, separates citation visibility from revenue, ranks defensive rewrites, and creates sponsor-safe evidence briefs.
searchSignals: Press Gazette — global publisher Google traffic dropped by a third in 2025: https://pressgazette.co.uk/media-audience-and-business-data/google-traffic-down-2025-trends-report-2026/
Reddit r/seogrowth — review sites lose SEO traffic while AI still quotes them: https://www.reddit.com/r/seogrowth/comments/1qtx65f/review_sites_lost_up_to_90_of_seo_traffic_so_why/
stitchPrompt: Design a financial analyst style publisher console called AI Citation Revenue Leak Map for independent publishers, niche review sites, affiliate operators, SEO consultants, creator newsletters, and local media teams facing AI-search traffic erosion. Users should import search-console rows, top content URLs, AI citation sightings, sponsor and affiliate value, and update cadence, then map page-level click leakage, separate citation visibility from actual revenue, rank defensive rewrites, and create sponsor-safe evidence briefs. Include a traffic/citation import, page-level click-leak heatmap, AI citation without click lane, sponsor and affiliate exposure table, defensive rewrite priority queue, community complaint quote shelf, and weekly revenue-risk brief. Design direction: use a financial-analyst aesthetic with crisp tables, dark-mode revenue charts, citation-vs-click deltas, scenario toggles, and CFO-readable risk summaries so the prototype feels like a money-defense terminal for publishers, not an SEO vanity dashboard.
